capabilities: read notes or selections aloud with sentence highlighting and seeking
export text as MP3 or subtitled MP4 with voice, speed and share info
dictate speech into notes via local or cloud recognition
configure system, offline and cloud speech providers with stored keys
import reading settings and keys from Qiaomu Reader
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mac-only features (Apple on-device recognition, system audio transcription) are on a development branch without a released signed installer. Mobile device playback and microphone acceptance are unverified. Browser system speech cannot be exported; cloud voices bill by character and tests may incur small charges.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in text-to-speech playback, audio or video export of notes, or speech-to-text dictation.

relations.evidence: Reading code is adapted from Qiaomu Reader (GPL-3.0)
cloud recognition provider protocols from Qiaomu Clipper (MIT)

requires.name: Sherpa/Python runtime installer for local SenseVoice

summary: Speech plugin that reads notes aloud with highlighted sentences, exports MP3/MP4 with subtitles, and dictates via local or cloud speech recognition.
